name: maatify/php-i18n
description: Maatify I18n module: language-aware translation keys, values, scopes and governance.

suggest.php-di/php-di: Required only to use the optional PHP-DI integration (Maatify\I18n\Adapter\PhpDi\I18nBindings). The core I18n runtime does not need it.
suggest.psr/container: Required only together with php-di/php-di for the optional PHP-DI integration.

scripts.check:style: php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php && php scripts/ci/test-per-cs-31.php && php scripts/ci/check-per-cs-31.php

scripts-descriptions.analyse: PHPStan level max over src, tests, examples and the consumer harness
scripts-descriptions.test: Unit suite, then the real-MySQL Integration suite
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration suite inside the Package-owned disposable MySQL lifecycle (Docker Compose v2)
scripts-descriptions.check:autoload: Strict optimized production autoload (--no-dev --strict-psr) and load of every src type
scripts-descriptions.check:syntax: php -l over every Package-owned PHP file
scripts-descriptions.check:whitespace: Trailing whitespace, CR and final-newline check over Package files
scripts-descriptions.check:docs: Documentation links, identity and release-claim consistency
scripts-descriptions.check:examples: Smoke-execute every example against the disposable MySQL
scripts-descriptions.check:audit: composer audit under the fail-closed dependency policy (needs Composer 2.10+)
scripts-descriptions.check:workflows: actionlint over every Host workflow (pinned, checksum-verified download; I18N_ACTIONLINT_USE_PATH=1 uses a local binary)
scripts-descriptions.verify:consumer: Consumer Verification Harness: two clean runs from a separate Composer root
scripts-descriptions.verify:static: Every local static, style, documentation, and workflow gate on the currently resolved dependency set
scripts-descriptions.verify: Canonical Package verification gate set on the currently installed or resolved dependency set; compatibility modes run separately
scripts-descriptions.check:style: Non-mutating PHP-FIG PER Coding Style 3.1 verification: pinned PER-CS 3.0 fixer rules plus repository-owned checks for every 3.1 delta
